02 / Profile

A practical maker with a social lens.

I turn unclear briefs into organized, audience-ready outputs — a content plan, a short-form video, an event run-of-show, a visual asset or a live digital experience.

I am an Information Security student at FPT University HCMC with hands-on experience in social content, AI-assisted web building, student event production and research-based technical projects.

My strongest pattern is learning fast, owning the workflow and shipping visible results. I bring an analytical mindset to research and reporting, then switch into maker mode for scripting, filming, editing and on-site execution.
